text:
omar: Heads-up: sudden spike in fncall validation rejects on canary at ~09:22 UTC. Reject rate ~5-6x. Lots of traffic falling to degen fallback and our costs are nudging up. Console sampling is almost zero so we have no examples.

jess: Canary only? Any user-facing failures yet? :eyes:

omar: Canary only for now. No customer reports. Need payloads to tell if adapter or validator is to blame.

ben: I shipped validators:v2.6.0-canary this morning with a tighter union->array coercion flag. It was intentional for canary.

claire: That flag disallows implicit coercion for ambiguous unions. It could hit adapters that send a single string where we expect an array.

omar: Example sanitized line: [09:23:10Z] route=fncall-eu-canary validator=validators:v2.6.0-canary outcome=REJECT reason="attachments: expected array, got string"

jess: Console only shows rollup counts. Can we get a short-lived dashboard panel breaking down reject_count by validator_version, route, fallback_route and sample_rate? Also an inspector to view redacted payload + model reply would help.

ben: I'll cut validators:v2.6.1 with a soft-coercion toggle and a debug backfill endpoint. Requesting sample override: route=fncall-eu-canary event=reject sample=100% duration=15m. This will flow through the redact pipeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling validators:v2.6.1 -> canary (owner: @ben)

jess: Approved: sample override 100% for 15m. Enable redact pipeline and add audit note. :white_check_mark:

product: product: To avoid billing surprises during canaries, implement a console "shadow-sandbox" routing option that sends fallback traffic to an observability-only sandbox (no billing, no quota) while retaining metrics. Default shadow for canaries.

ben: Good call. Will add routing_tag=shadow.sandbox and emit metrics: validation.reject_mode={hard,soft,coerced}, routing.fallback_type={shadow,real}, and fallback_cost_estimate histogram. Telemetry will mark shadowed events as non-billable.

claire: Dashboard inspector should include a validator fingerprint and adapter id so we can quickly triage adapter vs model vs validator.

omar: Short-term runbook: if samples show adapter emits wrong shape -> revert adapter; if model output varies -> revert validator strictness and run focused evals.

alert-bot: alert-bot: created incident INC-2026-810 "canary fncall validation spike" (owner: eng-platform)

jess: Thanks team. Ben/Omar post 2 redacted examples here when backfill completes and link the dashboard panel in the incident. Keep rollback options ready. :thumbsup:
